name: The Big Picture

angles.text: Northshire Valley serves as the training ground and sanctuary for fledgling Alliance champions, where keeping peace and recovering stolen goods from encroaching vermin is vital work.
Northshire Abbey is the cradle for newly recruited human adventurers stepping into service to protect Stormwind's outlying territories.

faq.answer: Shinyfinder Narf is a kobold leader located deep in the back of the mine near Northshire Valley. He has been hoarding stolen books and calling out for picture books, prompting local authorities to order his cache recovered.

aliases: why do kobolds want picture books
faq.answer: Kobolds venturing from the mine have been seen shouting 'Picture for Narf!' while snatching reading material. Rather than scholarly interest, Narf appears obsessed with gathering illustrated works, stuffing them into a sack deep within the tunnels.
faq.q: Why are the kobolds stealing books?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton is a resident of Northshire Abbey to whom the stolen books belong. Once the recovered sack of books reaches Marshal McBride, they are arranged to be returned directly to Brother Paxton's collection.

Marshal McBride is the local law enforcement officer stationed just inside Northshire Abbey, responsible for maintaining order, protecting the abbey grounds, and organizing defense against the local kobold menace.
Narf resides in the deeper, more dangerous recesses of the local mine in Northshire Valley, surrounded by meaner kobolds who defend their scavenged hoard.
faq.q: Where can Shinyfinder Narf be found?

faq.answer: While common kobolds outside the mine are nuisance scavengers, the kobolds dwelling deeper in the tunnels alongside Narf are far meaner and more hostile, making Narf and his den dangerous for solitary adventurers.
faq.q: How dangerous is the mine where Narf lives?

sections.body: A peculiar incident has disrupted the peace of Northshire Valley: kobolds lurking around the region have been seen scurrying away with books, crying out 'Picture for Narf!' While kobolds are typically infamous for scavenging candles and shiny trinkets, one particular cave-dweller known as Shinyfinder Narf has developed an appetite for illustrated tomes, accumulating a whole sack of them in his subterranean hideout.
sections.title: The Kobold Book Thief

sections.body: The deeper shafts of the mine shelter the tougher, meaner breeds of kobold who fiercely guard Narf and his odd hoard. Recovering the stolen literature requires braving these darker tunnels to confront Narf directly. Once pried from the creature's clutches, the sack of books is brought to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey, who ensures the valuable volumes are safely returned to Brother Paxton.
sections.title: Recovering the Abbey's Tomes

summary: The Big Picture is a Northshire Valley task concerning a thieving kobold named Shinyfinder Narf, who has been hoarding stolen books deep within the local mine. Adventurers are dispatched by local authorities to recover the illustrated volumes and return them to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
